# Brainbits

> An AI-native notes app for iOS. Capture ideas instantly, get answers from your notes, and stay organized without the friction.

Brainbits is designed for quick capture and long-term thinking. Notes save on device instantly — sync and AI processing run in the background so you're never waiting on a spinner.

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS (native Swift app, under 30 MB)
- Pricing: Generous free tier subject to limits; low-cost monthly subscription for premium features
- Capture: Saves on device instantly; network calls happen in the background
- AI: Cloud-based processing for organization and note search; zero data retention with AI providers
- Tagline: Note now, think later.
